messages:
Maya (PM): Heads-up: quick triage sync for post-launch follow-on. We have three customer asks + two regressions. Need to agree bug vs enhancement split and what goes into the next sprint. TL;DR: bug A is P0, bug B looks intermittent (P2), enhancements bundle C is nice-to-have. Can we decide owners + acceptance? cc @Dan (Eng) @Priya (SRE) @Leo (Design)

Dan (Eng): On it. Can you paste a quick repro for bug A? If it's a straightforward null-pointer we can patch and ship a hotfix in ~48h. For the enhancements, recommend a quick spike then schedule for Sprint+2.

Maya (PM): Bug A repro steps below. Telemetry shows ~12 occurrences in last 24h across 3 customers (IDs redacted). Repro snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"...","max_tokens":4096}'``` It fails when truncated headers are present and client sends an empty context.

Dan (Eng): Got it. Looks like a header-parsing edge case. I'll own a quick patch. Plan: branch `hotfix/bugA` -> add unit test + e2e repro -> run canary on 10% traffic -> promote if stable. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Priya (SRE): Canary plan sounds good. Add caveat: enable automatic fallback to smaller model variant if p95 latency spikes > 500ms during canary. Also I'll wire a rollback snippet into the runbook: `./ops deploy rollback --tag hotfix/bugA`. I'll set alerts for error-rate and p95.

Leo (Design): For enhancements (C1, C2) note that scope is larger than a copy tweak — C2 needs a small ux flow change. Estimate: ~2 design days + ~3 dev days each. Suggest we split: ship a small QoL (C1-lite) next sprint, defer the rest to Sprint+2.

Maya (PM): Proposal: 1) Ship bug A hotfix next sprint (owner: Dan). 2) Defer bug B unless we see >5 customers or >50 errors/day. 3) Include C1 (QoL) in next sprint, schedule C2 full work in Sprint+2. Acceptance criteria for hotfix: error-rate <1% for 48h post-promote AND no streaming regressions on canary traffic. Are we aligned?

Dan (Eng): :thumbsup: aligned. I'll open the branch + PR today and add tests + the e2e reproducer. Tagging @QA for review.

Priya (SRE): I'll add canary knobs (10/30/100) in infra, hook alerts to PagerDuty for the canary window, and add a dashboard tile that shows the error-rate + p95 for the affected route. Also adding a smoke check: `curl /health; curl /generate?sample=test` post-deploy.

QA-bot: Automated note: created REG-342 with repro steps + fixture; test required for merge.

Maya (PM): Great — action items recap: Dan = hotfix + PR, Leo = C1 design, Priya = canary + alerts, QA = regression tests. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30am PT for a quick unblock check. If anyone hits a blocker before then, ping me in this thread or @maya. Thanks!
